title: Service Contracts: adding named accounts and revising base rates mid-term
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product governs two kinds of amendment: naming additional accounts to book under the contract, and revising the contract's base rates during the term.

## Formal clauses
1. Named accounts may be added up to the tier's named-account maximum in total.
2. Rate revisions are possible only when the tier allows mid-term rate revision, and at most the tier's number of rate revisions per term.

## Decision table
| Request | Situation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Add a named account | the total named on the contract, the new one included, stays within the tier's maximum | may be added |
| Add a named account | the total would exceed the tier's maximum | not possible |
| Revise the base rates | the tier does not allow mid-term rate revision | not possible |
| Revise the base rates | the tier allows it and the term has had fewer revisions than the tier's number | possible |
| Revise the base rates | the tier allows it and the term has already had the tier's number of revisions | not possible |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical figures)
**A contract with a named-account maximum of 6 already names 6 accounts.** A seventh cannot be added, because the maximum applies to the total.

**A tier allows 2 rate revisions per term and one revision has been made this term.** One more revision is possible in this term.

**A tier does not allow mid-term rate revision.** No revision of the base rates is possible during the term, however few amendments have been filed.
